title: Billing snapshot truncation causing missed usage in CSV exports
creator: Aisha Patel
description: The nightly billing export job (CSV/ODS) is intermittently truncating the most recent hourly snapshot for tenants that had routing changes during autoscale or regional failover. Truncated snapshots lead to missing rows in customer invoice exports and under-reported usage for the last hour. Issue observed across Hosted + Dedicated hybrid tenants and on Private when the export window overlaps snapshot finalization. Initial analysis points to a race condition where the snapshot finalizer marks a snapshot as COMPLETE while the export orchestrator reads the snapshot manifest and applies a time-based cutoff that excludes newly-finalized fragments.
comments: 2026-03-05 - Customer Success flagged 3 customers with missing last-hour rows on invoices; tickets escalated. Took initial sample of exports and confirmed missing hourly rows in CSVs for runs between 00:50-01:10 UTC.

2026-03-06 - Reproduced in staging: simulate tenant routing change (move from hosted->dedicated) during snapshot window. Export job picks snapshot manifest earlier and applies cutoff which omits fragments appended <60s before export start.

2026-03-07 - Hypothesis: export orchestrator uses stateless manifest read with a max-age cutoff (60s) intended to avoid half-written fragments. When routing metadata changes, fragment commit latency increases and fragments are appended just after cutoff, causing omission. Discussed trade-offs: increase cutoff (backfill risk) vs atomically pinning snapshot manifest at export start (safer).

2026-03-09 - Mitigation deployed (hosted only): atomically lock snapshot manifest for export start and re-run export if manifest updated during read. Reduced incidence in canary tenants. Shared mitigation with CS to rerun exports for affected customers. Documented workaround in incident postmortem.

2026-03-11 - Root-cause PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9876 - implements export-time manifest pinning + idempotent re-run with backfill safety check. Added unit tests for manifest race and e2e test in CI that simulates routing change during export window.

2026-03-12 - QA: validated on Dedicated+Private staging with simulated autoscale evictions. Observed correct behavior for >200 simulated exports. Noted performance impact: median export job latency +8s due to pin/verify step. Engineering product trade-off meeting accepted latency increase for correctness; Optimize later.

2026-03-14 - Plan: merge PR after one more night of canary monitoring, schedule rollout to production global export pipeline on 2026-03-17 with a post-deploy 48h QA window. CS to notify affected customers and schedule invoice re-exports for last 30 days where truncation detected.

Acceptance criteria: no missing hourly rows observed for 48h in canary; automated regression test included; runbook updated; CS communications sent and re-export completed for known affected accounts.
